name: Mentalyc
description: Mentalyc is an AI documentation platform built exclusively for therapists, counselors, and mental health professionals. Unlike medical scribes designed for primary care, Mentalyc understands therapy modalities (CBT, DBT, psychodynamic, EMDR) and generates notes in therapy-specific formats (SOAP, DAP, BIRP, PIRP, GIRP, PIE, SIRP, and 100+ custom templates). The platform learns and adapts to individual clinicians' documentation styles. Unique feature: Alliance Genie tracks therapeutic alliance dynamics with data-driven insights—a capability no other scribe offers.

pricing.notes: 14-day free trial includes 15 notes, no credit card required. Annual billing reduces to $14.99-$99.99/mo. All plans include Alliance Genie therapeutic alliance tracking.

compliance.notes: SOC 2 Type II certified. Zero recording storage—audio deleted after note generation.

ambient_ai.description: Listens to sessions and generates modality-aware notes. Accepts recordings, dictation, summaries, transcripts, or typed text.

alliance_genie.description: Unique feature: tracks therapeutic alliance dynamics with data-driven insights into relationship patterns.

faqs.q: How much does Mentalyc cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Mentalyc offers five tiers: Mini ($19.99/mo, 10 notes), Basic ($39.99/mo, 50 notes), Pro ($69.99/mo, 160 notes), Super ($119.99/mo, 330 notes), and Group Practice ($49.99-59.99/seat, unlimited). Annual billing saves 20%. 14-day free trial includes 15 notes.

faqs.q: Does Mentalyc understand therapy modalities like CBT and DBT?
faqs.a: Yes. Unlike medical scribes, Mentalyc was built for therapy and understands modalities including CBT, DBT, psychodynamic, EMDR, solution-focused, and motivational interviewing. Notes reflect the actual therapeutic approach used.
Alliance Genie is Mentalyc's unique feature that tracks therapeutic alliance dynamics—providing data-driven insights into the therapist-client relationship. No other AI scribe offers this capability.

faqs.q: Which EHRs does Mentalyc integrate with?
faqs.a: Mentalyc has direct integrations with TherapyNotes, ICANotes, TheraNest, Valant, and TheraBill. SimplePractice and Jane App work via Chrome Extension for one-click note autofill.

faqs.q: Is Mentalyc better than Freed AI for therapists?
faqs.a: For psychotherapy documentation, yes. Freed is a medical scribe that doesn't understand therapy modalities or generate therapy-specific notes. Mentalyc was built specifically for therapists with modality-aware AI and formats like DAP, BIRP, and GIRP.
